domains.intro: The workspace is sliced vertically: every domain (a part of the app) owns its libraries, split into layers by what they do. Folders follow libs//-; libs/shared holds what several domains use. Generated from the Nx project graph.

api.text: The GraphQL schema and resolvers (@cv/api), answered in the browser for now.

data-access.text: A root signal store (NgRx Signals) that loads once and is shared app-wide. Internally a service runs a typed GraphQL query and a mapper turns the generated API types into hand-written frontend types.

feature.text: A routed page. Injects a store and renders its signals.

ui-util.text: Presentational components and plain functions or types, shared without knowing about data.
ui-util.title: ui and util

not-available.text: The architecture is generated at build time and is not available here. Run npx nx run technical-data-access-build-info:build-info.
not-available.title: Architecture not available

entry.text: Every library exports its public API from src/index.ts, imported as @cv/. Deep imports into a library are not allowed.
entry.title: One entry point

lazy.text: Feature libraries export their page by name, so a route lazy-loads it with loadComponent: () => import('@cv/…').then((m) => m.Page).
lazy.title: Lazy pages

private.text: What the barrel does not export lives in src/lib/internal/. A lint rule stops a barrel from exporting anything from there.
private.title: Private by default

rules.intro: checks every import against these rules from sheriff.config.ts, in ESLint and with sheriff verify. A module needs clearance on both its tags: its domain and its layer.
rules.label: Dependency rules
rules.none: nothing: it depends on no other module

lib.intro: The opposite approach, for comparison: the component ships with this app instead of being loaded from another deployment.

step.bundle: This app installs it and bundles it at build time, so nothing is loaded at runtime.
step.element: It also ships as the web component (@axel-pauwels/mac-window/element), for any framework.
step.publish: It is published to npm as @axel-pauwels/mac-window.

lib.subtitle: Bundled at build time, from this repository
lib.title: Component library: <lib-mac-window>

mfe.intro: A separate Angular app with its own repository and deployment. This app does not contain its code: it is loaded in the browser, when this page opens.

step.manifest: At startup, initFederation() reads federation.manifest.json, which maps the name cv-mfe to the remote’s remoteEntry.json.
step.register: That module registers the custom element (Angular Elements), and the wrapper adds it to the page.
step.shared: Angular and RxJS are shared with this app as singletons (Native Federation), so they are downloaded once.

mfe.subtitle: Loaded at runtime, from its own deployment
mfe.title: Micro-frontend: <cv-mfe>
